$comment: contract-version 0.1.0 — initial durable per-plugin state contract (RFC molecule-ai-sdk#181, defect A of molecule-ai-workspace-runtime#360). Delivery half of plugin-manifest `contributes.state`. GENERALISES the shipped trigger-state seam (molecule_runtime/trigger_state.py: MOLECULE_TRIGGER_STATE_DIR resolved by the runtime and injected into the daemon subprocess) from kind:trigger-only and /configs-rooted to kind-agnostic and durable-rooted, and reuses the shipped durability detector (mailbox_dir.probe_durability) as a DOWNGRADE-only corroboration of the provisioner's declaration. Every literal below is `const`-pinned so a consumer reads the constant instead of re-typing it — the one pattern that held after three 'fixed in one place, not the other' regressions on #360.
title: Durable Per-Plugin State Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for the durable per-plugin state directory. A plugin DECLARES that it keeps restart-surviving state via plugin-manifest `contributes.state`; this contract is the DELIVERY SSOT for what that declaration produces — the provisioner-injected durable root, the reserved daemon environment variables carrying the resolved per-plugin directory and its honest durability flag, the per-plugin directory template and mode, the degradation policy when no durable root exists, and the migration path for plugins that already guessed one. The SDK owns this SHAPE + constants; molecule-controlplane owns PROVISIONING a durable root on every substrate; molecule_runtime owns RESOLVING the per-plugin directory and INJECTING it at daemon spawn. Mirrors the workspace-data contract's three-way ownership split.

_doc.description: Free-form documentation block (array of prose lines). Not machine-validated.

ownership.description: The three-way split. Each owner is pinned so a consumer cannot quietly take over another leg.

shape_owner.description: Owns the SHAPE + constants (this contract) and the declaration surface in plugin-manifest.

provisioner_owner.description: Owns PROVISIONING a durable root on every substrate and injecting box_env.state_root. Nothing else may claim a path is durable.

injector_owner.description: Owns RESOLVING the per-plugin directory from the declared manifest identity and INJECTING the reserved daemon env at spawn.

declaration_surface.description: Where a plugin declares that it needs durable state. This contract never re-declares it.

generalizes.description: The shipped seam this contract generalises. Recorded so review can check that v1 is an EXTENSION of working code rather than a parallel invention — and so the follow-up to converge the original is not lost.

seam.description: The import-light module that already resolves one per-plugin-class state dir for both the runtime API and the daemon subprocess.

existing_env.description: The env var that seam already injects — the naming and semantics this contract copies.

existing_injection_site.description: Where the existing injection happens today (the channel-socket binder, trigger lane only).

existing_root.description: The root the existing seam uses, which is NOT durable on every substrate — the thing v1 changes.

items.description: One difference between the existing seam and this contract.

what_changes.description: The precise delta, so review can size it.

trigger_state_keeps_working.description: Explicit statement that v1 does not break or re-root the existing trigger seam.

box_env.description: Provisioner -> container. The ONLY signal that a durable root exists. Absent = no durable root on this box.

state_root.description: In-container absolute path of the durable root the provisioner created and BINDS ACROSS RECREATE. Injected ONLY when the provisioner actually made it durable — never speculatively. Not forwarded to daemons; the runtime resolves the per-plugin directory from it.

daemon_env.description: Runtime -> plugin daemon. RESERVED: stripped from the inherited environment before a daemon's own `env` map is applied, exactly like the channel A2A socket vars, so a manifest cannot forge either value.

state_dir.description: Absolute path of the plugin's OWN state directory — already namespaced by the platform, created 0700, ready to write. Name adopted from discord-channel-molecule, which reached for it before any producer existed.

durable.description: Whether that directory actually survives a container swap / instance recreate on THIS box. The machine-readable half of loud degradation: a plugin branches on it instead of assuming.

durable_false.description: Value meaning NOT durable — writable, but lost on recreate.

reserved.description: Both vars are runtime-owned capabilities, not ordinary workspace env: popped from the inherited environment before spec.env is overlaid.

state_dir_is_already_namespaced.description: state_dir is the plugin's directory, NOT a root to append a name to. Delegating namespacing to the plugin would hand directory identity back to the untrusted side.

paths.description: Where state lands. The plugin has NO say in any of it — that is the defect being fixed.

default_root.description: Default in-container durable root. Chosen because it is OUTSIDE /workspace and /configs (both destroyed and re-seeded by the local-docker teardown path), is runtime-agnostic rather than keyed on a runtime's own dotdir, sits under the platform-owned `.molecule` namespace the SDK already uses for its token cache, and is baked by NO maintained runtime image — the bind-shadowing hazard that forced hermes to persist only /home/agent/.hermes/auth rather than the whole dotdir.

fallback_root.description: Used when box_env.state_root is absent. Writable everywhere, reported DURABLE=0 unconditionally even where /workspace happens to be durable — deliberately conservative, because reporting durable-when-not is the failure mode that caused #360 and reporting ephemeral-when-durable only costs a plugin a redundant lookback.

dir_template.description: One directory per plugin, shared by ALL of that plugin's daemons — they are one plugin and one trust domain.

mode.description: Directory mode. Excludes other uids; see isolation for why it is not a boundary between plugins.

owner_uid.description: The agent user every runtime execs as.

identity_source.description: plugin_name comes from the VALIDATED manifest identity the runtime already uses for channel provenance — never the install directory, never a plugin-supplied string.

durability_signal.description: How MOLECULE_PLUGIN_STATE_DURABLE is decided: provisioner DECLARES, probe may only DOWNGRADE.

credits_durable_when.description: ALL must hold to report durable_true.

provisioner_declared.description: Durability originates from the provisioner, not from an in-container guess.

detector.description: The shipped probe reused as corroboration. DOWNGRADE-only.

why_not_probe_alone.description: The measured counter-example that rules out probing alone.

why_not_declaration_alone.description: Why the declaration still needs a falsifier.

degradation.description: What happens on a substrate with no durable storage. The load-bearing decision of this contract.

policy.description: A writable directory and an honest flag are ALWAYS injected.

on_no_state_root.description: The concrete behaviour when box_env.state_root is absent.

log_level_required.description: Log level when the manifest declared durability:required and the substrate cannot honour it.

log_level_preferred.description: Log level when the manifest declared durability:preferred.

never_fail_spawn.description: A missing durable root NEVER prevents the daemon from starting.

never_fail_manifest_validation.description: A malformed or unsatisfiable state declaration NEVER fails manifest validation or the install gate.

rationale.description: The argument for degrade-loudly over fail-closed.

migration.description: How a plugin that already guessed a path adopts this contract.

platform_moves_data.description: Neither the provisioner nor the runtime relocates a plugin's existing files.

plugin_pattern.description: On first boot with state_dir set, copy each legacy file that is ABSENT at the target. A file already at the target always wins, so a second boot can never overwrite live state with a stale copy.

never_delete_legacy.description: Copy-only. Rollback stays a clean revert and no deletion-path review is triggered.

unset_state_dir_means.description: An unset state_dir means the runtime predates this contract, NOT that state is unwanted — the plugin keeps its current path so a new plugin runs on an old runtime.

boundary.description: What the directory separation actually is.

escape_prevented_by.description: The properties that stop a plugin naming, redirecting or escaping its own directory.

not_a_privilege_boundary_because.description: The limitation, stated up front rather than discovered later.

substrates.description: Per-substrate wiring status. `unwired` entries are exactly the work the provisioner leg must do.

provisioner.description: The controlplane file that owns it.

status.description: Whether a durable plugin-state root exists there TODAY.

mechanism.description: How durability is achieved on this substrate and what must be added.

no_durable_root_when.description: The condition under which even a wired substrate yields no durable root — the case degradation must handle.

workspace_data_interaction.description: How this contract behaves before and after the workspace-data R2 default flips, since both claim to be about durability.

after_default_on.description: Behaviour once it defaults true — and why the flip alone changes nothing here.

must_not.description: The cross-contract mistake a consumer must not make.

known_consumers.description: Plugins already reading a contract env var before a producer existed. Recorded because they constrain the naming.

reads.description: The env var it already reads.

note.description: How its expectation differs from this contract and what that costs.

open.description: Deliberately deferred in v1. Present so scope creep is visible rather than silent.

uninstall.description: Reclaiming a directory on uninstall — a deletion path needing its own review.

trigger_reroot.description: Converging the existing trigger-state seam onto this root.
